name: ghostbot
description: GhostBot — a free, open-source desktop AI agent. Bring your own LLM (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
author: GhostBot contributors

scripts.//build: Packages are built in dependency order. `--workspaces` runs them in an arbitrary order, which breaks a fresh clone: everything imports @ghostbot/shared, and TypeScript resolves it to dist/ that does not exist yet.
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ghostbot/shared && npm run build --workspace @ghostbot/tools && npm run build --workspace @ghostbot/llm && npm run build --workspace @ghostbot/mcp && npm run build --workspace @ghostbot/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ghostbot/desktop
scripts.//typecheck: Typechecking also needs the declaration files, so build the packages first. On a fresh clone this is the difference between a clean run and a wall of TS2307.
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
